name: studyvillage

scripts.test: vitest run --config app/vitest.config.ts && vitest run --config server/vitest.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config app/vite.config.ts && node scripts/build-pwa.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run i18n:check && npm run build && npm run server:build
scripts.server:dev: node server/build.mjs && DATA_DIR=./server/data ALLOWED_ORIGINS=* node server/dist/server.mjs
scripts.i18n:audit: AUDIT_OUT=test-results/i18n-audit.json playwright test --config app/playwright.config.ts audit/crawl.spec.ts && python3 scripts/i18n-audit-report.py test-results/i18n-audit.json
scripts.linux:build: node node_modules/electron/install.js && npm run build && node scripts/build-linux.mjs
scripts.windows:build: npm run build && node scripts/package-platform.mjs win32 x64
scripts.mac:build: npm run build && node scripts/package-platform.mjs darwin x64
scripts.mac:arm64:build: npm run build && node scripts/package-platform.mjs darwin arm64

description: StudyVillage — local-first pixel-art study village rebuild
